Name: Millnificent (Better Mill) (CP)
Author: Molenfeuer
Description:
[size=5][img align=left]https://i.imgur.com/Fxdvab9.png[/img] [b] Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the newest version of this mod from NexusMods or the GitHub [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/Millnificent/releases]release page[/url]﻿
[*]Extract the ZIP-File and put the folder into the mods folder of SMAPI (mostly located under "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods")
[/list]
[b][color=#ffe599] ﻿﻿Notes:
[/color][/b][list]
[*][color=#ffe599]Please make sure to also install ALL Requirements from the [url=https://imgur.com/3e2dLmQ][u][color=#ffe599]Requirements tab[/color][/u][/url]﻿![/color]
[/list][size=5]
[img align=left]https://i.imgur.com/Fxdvab9.png[/img] [b] Usage[/b][/size]
You can buy this Mill in Robins [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Carpenter%27s_Shop]Carpenter's Shop[/url] for the same price as the original ""mill"":
[list]
[*]150x Wood 🪵
[*]50x Stone 🪨
[*]4x Cloth 🧵
[*]2.500g 🪙
[/list][size=5]
[img align=left]https://i.imgur.com/Fxdvab9.png[/img] [b] Options[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]🎨🖌️ You can change the color of the mill as you wish.
[/list][list]
[*]For those who want some alternative sprites, I have included skins created by other great artists and myself! If you've created your own skin for Millnificent and want to share it, please let me know!
[*]Available languages: 🇬🇧 🇩🇪 🇪🇸 🇫🇷 🇧🇷 (Help me translate it into your language ;) )
[/list][size=5]
[img align=left]https://i.imgur.com/Fxdvab9.png[/img] [b] Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds an alternative mill
[/list][size=5]
[img align=left]https://i.imgur.com/Fxdvab9.png[/img] [b] Contribute[/b][/size]
If something doesn't work, or you miss a feature, feel free to open a new issue on the [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/Millnificent/issues]GitHub Page of this mod[/url]. I prefer the GitHub Page but if you really don't want to use it feel free to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16890?tab=bugs]Issue Page here on NexusMods[/url].
[size=5]
[img align=left]https://i.imgur.com/Fxdvab9.png[/img] [b] Credits[/b][/size]
